title: Recuperating From a Severe Illness
description: As Anna has been recovering from her illness, she's finally started playing all around the city again. However, Anthony can't seem to find her anywhere...

mainQuestExcel.title: Recuperating From a Severe Illness
mainQuestExcel.description: As Anna has been recovering from her illness, she's finally started playing all around the city again. However, Anthony can't seem to find her anywhere...

dialogs.text: How did this happen...
What's wrong?
Oh, it's you. Just in time, too. Anna's been getting better ever since eating the medicine prescribed by that doctor.
When she wasn't well, she needed a lot of rest, and so spent a lot of time convalescing at home.
Now that she's better, she's started pestering me every day to go out at play, and I couldn't refuse her.
But now, I absolutely cannot find her. I have no idea where she's gone. Please help me find her!
I... Alright.
I'll be waiting here. Please hurry.
She just got better, and now she's scampering about. What will we do if something happens to her...?
I've already been searching for quite a while. I haven't looked in the vicinity of the Adventurers' Guild yet, but I'm just beat at this point...
You should start your search over there. Who knows, maybe Cyrus has noticed something...
I hope you find her, or I'll have to go out again...
You seem quite happy about it.
Happy? This is no laughing matter. She's only gotten a little better, and now she's flying about like a kite!
When she gets back, I'll give her what for.
She'll come back once she gets hungry.
Are you taking my sister for some sort of cat? And she's only just recovered. How can we let her go hungry?
Alright, alright. Please help me find her, I'll be waiting for you here.
The wind feels great here. I'd love to see how it feels in some faraway place.
I'm so high up! My brother will never find me here!
What are you doing here...
Wah! How'd you get up here, and without a sound, too!
No, wait. How did you even find me?
Me? I just climbed up here.
My brother's looking for me? Huh. It's been some time, hasn't it? I hadn't noticed.
I got it. I'll go back soon. Just let me stay here for a while...
Have you found Anna?
She's on top of a windmill.
A windmill!? How did that girl get up there? I'm calling the Knights of Favonius right now!
She said she'll be back soon.
O—Oh. Is that so? Well, she's fine, and that's what matters. You scared me there for a moment! I thought she was stuck on top of a windmill.
Thank you, I'll go look for her now.
Running off like that when she's only just recovered... I have to teach her a lesson.
The wind feels great here. I'd love to see how it feels in some faraway place.
Oh? You're here? That's unusual.
Have you seen a certain girl?
A girl? Oh, you mean Anna? I did see her. She was heading for that windmill over there.
I'm still quite puzzled by it, myself. I thought she was unwell. Where did she suddenly get all that energy from?
She greeted me and just ran by.
That kid... Do you have any idea when she recovered from her illness?
Once I find Anna, I'll have to teach her a lesson.
I'm so high up! My brother will never find me here!
What are you doing here...
Whoa! How'd you get up here, and without a sound, too!
Also, how did you even find me?
Ah, I know. Mr. Cyrus must have told you.
He's always taken care of my brother and I, and I greeted him as I was passing by. He looked so surprised, too!
Maybe I should try out for the Adventurers' Guild and become an Adventurer. That might be nice!
What? My brother's looking for me? Huh. It's been some time, hasn't it? I hadn't noticed at all!
I got it. Just let me stay here for a while, I'll go back myself.
Once I find Anna, I'll have to teach her a lesson.
It seems like that kid has recovered from her illness.
Have you found Anna yet?
She's on top of a windmill.
A windmill!? How did that girl get up there? I'm going up there right now...
What? She wants to try becoming an adventurer?
She's getting ahead of herself, she hasn't even fully recovered yet!
Don't get me wrong. Once she's well, I don't have any problems with her going out to see the world.
Thanks, I'll go look for her. Running off like that when she's only just recovered... I have to teach her a lesson.
The wind feels great here. I'd love to see how it feels in some faraway place.
It seems like that kid has recovered from her illness.
